sentences.text:
By way of present petition filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
petitioner seeks quashing of FIR (Annexure P-1) and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

Details of the FIR are as follows:
FIR No. Dated Sections Police Station 15 20.01.2021 406, 420, 506 and 120-B of Kalayat, District IPC Kaithal, Haryana.

3. On the asking of the Court, Mr. Praveen Bhadu, AAG, Haryana, who is present in Court, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent-State and filed status report dated 10.03.2025 in the form of affidavit of Deputy Superintendent of Police, Kalayat, which is taken on record and copy thereof has been supplied to learned counsel for the petitioner.

4. Heard.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:035309 Aparna Puri vs State Of Haryana And Another on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35682235/
1 5.
It is categorically stated by learned State counsel that after investigation in the FIR (Annexure P-1), cancellation report has been submitted before the learned Illaqa Magistrate on 03.03.2025.

6. Faced with this situation, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as the cancellation report has been submitted before the learned Illaqa Magistrate in the instant FIR, therefore, at this stage, he seeks withdrawal of the present petition with liberty to file the same afresh with better particulars, if so required in future in accordance with law.
7. However, it is clarified that the withdrawal of the instant petition will not, in any manner, affect the proceedings carried out by learned trial Court qua the aforesaid cancellation.
8. Dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.
9. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
